name: pyautogui_mouse_click
description:
Click a mouse button at the given (x, y) screen coordinates, or at the current cursor position if coordinates are omitted.

Works on Linux/WSLg X11 apps. Set `double: true` for double-click. `button` defaults to "left".

Returns the cursor position after the click.

x.description: X screen coordinate to click (omit to click at current position)

double.description: Send a double-click instead of single-click
